en.title: K-P-P
en.decryption: Refers to the two major assemblies (Kannauj & Prayag) and his practice of the 'Pancha-Varshika' (five-yearly) charity distribution.

fact.en: Mistake: Assuming Harsha abandoned other religions. Fact: He remained tolerant and worshipped both Shiva and Buddha.
fact.hi: Mistake: Assuming Harsha abandoned other religions. Fact: He remained tolerant and worshipped both Shiva and Buddha.

fact.en: Mistake: Thinking Harsha was a Buddhist since birth. Fact: He was a devout Shaivite/Surya-worshipper in his early years.
fact.hi: Mistake: Thinking Harsha was a Buddhist since birth. Fact: He was a devout Shaivite/Surya-worshipper in his early years.

fact.en: Mistake: Confusing Kannauj assembly with the Prayag assembly. Kannauj was doctrinal; Prayag was for charity.
fact.hi: Mistake: Confusing Kannauj assembly with the Prayag assembly. Kannauj was doctrinal; Prayag was for charity.
